title: 冰为什么会化
subtitle: 同一样东西，三种样子
character: wearing a white t-shirt, blue shorts and sandals, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, cool gouache painting on textured paper, flat simple shapes with fine blue-grey outlines, palette of pale ice blue, cool cyan and warm cream, soft brush texture

pages.zh:
我在杯子里放了一块冰。
它先是硬硬的，
后来变小了，
最后不见了，
杯子里只剩下水。
pages.scene: The little boy holds a clear glass with one ice cube in it, looking closely at the cube through the side of the glass.

pages.zh:
冰和水是同一样东西。
它们都是水做的，
只是样子不一样。
水还有第三个样子：
看不见的水蒸气。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three glasses in a row on a cream background: one holding an ice cube, one holding water, one empty with small arrows rising from it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
水是由很多很小的
「分子」组成的。
小到看不见，
可是它们一直在动，
从来不停。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one square on a pale background filled with many small round particles, each with a tiny motion mark beside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
在冰里，
分子挨得很紧，
排成整整齐齐的格子，
只能在原地抖，
走不开。所以冰是硬的。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one square on a pale background filled with round particles arranged in a neat regular grid. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
热会让分子动得更快。
动得够快，
它们就挣开了格子，
能挤着往前走了。
冰就变成了水。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two squares side by side on a pale background: the left filled with particles in a neat grid, the right filled with the same particles jumbled and close together. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
水里的分子挨得还是很近，
所以水挤不小；
可是能互相滑过去，
所以水会流，
倒进什么形状就是什么形状。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one glass and one wide bowl side by side on a cream background, the same amount of water taking a different shape in each. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
再热一点，
表面的分子会一个一个跑掉，
飞到空气里，
变成水蒸气。
它们离得很远，到处乱跑。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one square on a pale background with only a few round particles in it, spread far apart with motion marks. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
水蒸气遇到冷，
又会挤回一起变成水。
所以冰镇的杯子外面
会挂上一层小水珠，
那不是漏出来的。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one cold glass on a cream background with small round droplets drawn on its outside surface. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
冰化的时候要吸热。
它把周围的热
一点点拿走，
所以饮料才会变凉，
手拿着也会觉得冷。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one ice cube in a glass on a cream background with several small arrows pointing from the water into the cube. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
冰比水轻，
所以冰块浮在水面上。
因为结冰的时候，
分子排成的格子
把空间撑得更开了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one glass of water on a cream background with one ice cube floating at the surface, most of it under the water line. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
别的东西也有三个样子。
铁烧到很热会变成液体，
空气冷到很冷会变成液体。
只是水的三个样子，
在我们身边最常见。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three small pictures in a row on a cream background: a solid block, a puddle, and a few spread-out specks. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我又拿了一块冰
放在手心里。
它一点点变小，
手心一点点变凉。
它没有不见，它只是换了个样子。
pages.scene: The little boy holds one small melting ice cube in his open palm, watching it, a drop of water running down his hand.
